items.title_en: Lean Verification of the Riemann Hypothesis - Joint statement by...
items.title_zh: 用 Lean 验证黎曼猜想——联合声明
items.summary_en: Levent Alpöge released a Lean library containing a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis on November 20, 2026. The library comprises 17 million lines of code. The Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement endorsing the verification, with support from the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 20 日，Levent Alpöge 发布了一个包含黎曼猜想证明的 Lean 库。该库包含 1700 万行代码。Lean 和 Mathlib 社区随后发表联合声明，Lean FRO 与 Mathlib Initiative 也表示支持这项验证工作。

items.title_en: Derek Lowe: Detonating a Pile of Lead Azide
items.title_zh: Derek Lowe：引爆一大堆叠氮化铅
items.summary_en: The piece concerns the detonation of a large pile of lead azide. Lead azide is an explosive compound, making the incident a hazardous chemistry event.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容涉及引爆一大堆叠氮化铅。叠氮化铅是一种爆炸性化合物，因此这是一起危险的化学实验事件。

items.title_en: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH
items.title_zh: 仓促公告：Alessandro Masullo 的广义黎曼猜想证明
items.summary_en: Alessandro Masullo has proposed a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. Brian Conrad has reviewed it closely for months, provided extensive feedback, and considers the draft to be looking good so far. The authors had hoped to refine it at Stanford before announcing it, but decided to release the current draft so others could check and formalize it.
items.summary_zh: Alessandro Masullo 提出了一份广义黎曼猜想的证明。Brian Conrad 已经对其进行了数月的仔细审阅，并提供了大量反馈，目前认为证明草稿看起来不错。原计划是在斯坦福进一步完善后再公布，但现在决定先发布当前版本，供其他人检查和形式化。

items.title_en: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]
items.title_zh: Levent Alpöge 声称证明了广义黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: Levent Alpöge claims to have found a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. The claim is presented in a PDF.
items.summary_zh: Levent Alpöge 声称找到了广义黎曼猜想的证明。相关论证以 PDF 形式发布。

items.title_en: My Monitor Was Cutting My Download Speed by 75%
items.title_zh: 我的显示器让下载速度下降了 75%
items.summary_en: A 2.5 Gbps symmetrical internet connection produced 2.4 Gbps uploads but only 600 Mbps downloads. The same result appeared on another laptop, while the ISP found no problem on its side. The investigation traced the bottleneck to a Studio Display XDR, a small buffer, and a USB burst size of four packets.
items.summary_zh: 一条上下行对称 2.5 Gbps 的网络连接，上传速度达到 2.4 Gbps，但下载速度只有 600 Mbps。在另一台笔记本电脑上测试也得到相同结果，而 ISP 检查后未发现其网络存在问题。调查最终将瓶颈定位到 Studio Display XDR、一个较小的缓冲区，以及每次四个数据包的 USB 突发大小。

items.title_en: Inkling 2 Mini
items.title_zh: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights model small enough to run on a laptop. It is a looped transformer that runs its middle layers three times per token, allowing it to reason more and use fewer tokens. The model reportedly leads open-weights models under 100 billion total parameters on DeepSWE v1.1 and Vals Index v2.2, while also running faster than similarly performing models.
items.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一款小到可以在笔记本电脑上运行的开放权重模型。它采用循环 Transformer，每个 token 将中间层运行三次，从而进行更多推理并减少 token 使用量。据称，在总参数量低于 1000 亿的开放权重模型中，它在 DeepSWE v1.1 和 Vals Index v2.2 上处于领先，同时运行速度也快于性能相近的模型。

items.title_en: Astra 6.2 and Sol 6.2 flop at Simple Bench
items.title_zh: Astra 6.2 和 Sol 6.2 在 SimpleBench 中表现不佳
items.summary_en: SimpleBench is a multiple-choice benchmark with more than 200 questions covering spatiotemporal reasoning, social intelligence, and trick-question robustness. A nonspecialist human baseline scored 83.7%, based on nine participants, while the best listed model, Claude Fable, scored 81.9%. The benchmark reports that every tested LLM underperformed the human baseline.
items.summary_zh: SimpleBench 是一个包含 200 多道选择题的基准测试，考察时空推理、社交智能和应对陷阱题的能力。由 9 名参与者组成的非专业人类基线得分为 83.7%，而列出的最佳模型 Claude Fable 得分为 81.9%。该基准测试显示，所有受测 LLM 的表现都低于人类基线。

items.title_en: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
items.title_zh: 据报道，FBI 正调查其刑事数据库遭入侵事件
items.summary_en: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal information database, according to US media reports citing two people briefed on the matter. The National Crime Information Center is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information on warrants and background checks. The FBI has been contacted for comment.
items.summary_zh: 据援引两名知情人士的美国媒体报道，FBI 正在调查其刑事信息数据库疑似遭到入侵的事件。国家犯罪信息中心供联邦和地方执法机构共享逮捕令及背景调查信息。FBI 已被联系以置评。

items.title_en: RCE in Gnupg
items.title_zh: GnuPG 中存在远程代码执行风险
items.summary_en: GPGME 2.3.1 fixes a critical security bug affecting all prior versions, and updated Gpg4win and GnuPG desktop packages also include the fix. An OpenPGP key with a crafted, very long user ID can trigger a double free and potentially exfiltrate data from applications processing signed data. The advisory says remote code execution cannot be ruled out and urges immediate updates; the flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-129975.
items.summary_zh: GPGME 2.3.1 修复了一个影响所有先前版本的严重安全漏洞，更新后的 Gpg4win 和 GnuPG 桌面软件包也包含该修复。攻击者可通过带有特制超长用户 ID 的 OpenPGP 密钥触发 double free，并可能从处理签名数据的应用程序中窃取数据。公告称无法排除远程代码执行的可能性，并敦促用户立即更新；该漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-129975。

items.title_en: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?
items.title_zh: 问 HN：我失业两年了，有 15 年经验，在美国该怎么办？
items.summary_en: A senior software engineer in the US DMV area says they have been unemployed for two years after leaving an insurance technology company in January 2025. They have 15 years of experience, continue tutoring mathematics, and may soon manage a pizzeria, but have found no software engineering job despite skills in C#/.NET, AWS, and AI. With only four to five months of savings left, they are asking for well-paid alternatives to software engineering or adjacent work.
items.summary_zh: 一名居住在美国 DMV 地区的资深软件工程师表示，自己在 2025 年 1 月离开一家保险科技公司后已失业两年。此人拥有 15 年经验，目前继续辅导数学，并可能很快开始担任披萨店经理，但尽管具备 C#/.NET、AWS 和 AI 技能，仍未找到软件工程工作。由于积蓄只够支撑四到五个月，对方正在寻求软件工程或相关领域之外的高薪替代路径。

items.title_en: We promoted developers into architects without informing them
items.title_zh: 我们把开发者提拔成架构师，却没有告诉他们
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI-assisted coding shifts developers’ work toward architecture and product judgment. A performance bug in a Google Forms add-on was traced to AI-generated logging that recorded user email information despite Google’s restrictions. The proposed fix is to log only the timestamp, show the welcome screen first, and tell marketing which installation data is unavailable.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，AI 辅助编程正在把开发者的工作重心转向架构和产品判断。一个 Google Forms 插件的性能问题，最终被追溯到 AI 生成的日志代码：它记录了用户邮箱，而 Google 已限制可获取的用户信息。作者提出的修复方案是只记录时间戳、先显示欢迎界面，并告知市场团队安装时无法获取哪些数据。

items.title_en: Backblaze Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy
items.title_zh: Backblaze 收集信息声明与隐私政策
items.summary_en: Backblaze's privacy notice explains how the company collects, uses, discloses, processes, and retains personal information, as well as how people can exercise their privacy rights. Backblaze is a US-based data-storage company offering Computer Backup for Mac and PC devices and B2 Cloud Storage for organizations and individuals.
items.summary_zh: Backblaze 的隐私声明说明了公司如何收集、使用、披露、处理和保留个人信息，以及用户如何行使隐私权。Backblaze 是一家总部位于美国的数据存储公司，为个人和组织提供面向 Mac 与 PC 设备的 Computer Backup，以及 B2 Cloud Storage 云存储服务。

items.title_en: Unforced Navier-Stokes Singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 无外力 Navier–Stokes 奇异性与广义黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: Terence Tao lists recent results involving unforced Euler and Navier–Stokes equations, the Riemann Hypothesis, and researchers including Levent Alpöge and Tristan Buckmaster. He says the results will be reported more widely, while noting that their current level of digestion varies. The post is dated November 20, 2026.
items.summary_zh: Terence Tao 列出了涉及无外力 Euler 方程、Navier–Stokes 方程、黎曼猜想以及 Levent Alpöge、Tristan Buckmaster 等研究者的最新结果。他表示，这些结果还会在其他渠道广泛报道，同时指出目前对这些成果的理解和整理程度各不相同。该文章发表于 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

items.title_en: NINLIVE: The Nine Inch Nails live archive
items.title_zh: NINLIVE：九寸钉现场档案
items.summary_en: NINLIVE is a fan-run archive of Nine Inch Nails concerts, setlists, recordings, posters, and photos from 1988 onward. It now lets users stream live recordings from 1988 through 2026, in addition to downloading them. Users can log in with Discord to save and organize favorites.
items.summary_zh: NINLIVE 是一个由粉丝运营的九寸钉现场档案，收录自 1988 年以来的演唱会、歌单、录音、海报和照片。该站现在除了提供下载，还支持在线播放 1988 至 2026 年的现场录音。用户可以使用 Discord 登录，以保存和整理喜欢的录音。

items.title_en: ClawDOS – An AI coding agent for DOS
items.title_zh: ClawDOS：面向 DOS 的 AI 编程代理
items.summary_en: ClawDOS is an AI chat and coding harness designed to run on DOS. It operates on an IBM PC XT with an 8088 processor running at 4.77 MHz, 640 KB of RAM, and a CGA graphics card.
items.summary_zh: ClawDOS 是一个运行在 DOS 上的 AI 聊天与编程工具。它可以在配备 4.77 MHz 8088 处理器、640 KB 内存和 CGA 显卡的 IBM PC XT 上运行。

items.title_en: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.title_zh: 语言模型可以重写自己的权重
items.summary_en: Researchers describe a self-rewriting method in which a language model diagnoses its failures and edits its own weights without gradients or another training run. An open 27-billion-parameter model improved its accuracy by 6.6 points on unseen problems after its own edit. Across eight sessions, it repeatedly tested edits and retained only those that improved performance, and it restored a damaged copy to more than 80% of its original image-task accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员介绍了一种自我重写方法：语言模型无需梯度或重新训练，就能诊断自身失败并修改权重。一个拥有 270 亿参数的开放模型在自我修改后，在未见过的问题上的准确率提高了 6.6 个百分点。模型在八个连续会话中反复测试修改，只保留能提升性能的版本，并将一个受损副本恢复到原始图像任务准确率的 80% 以上。

items.title_en: If you can't explain something in simple terms, you don't understand it (2017)
items.title_zh: 如果你无法用简单的话解释某件事，你其实并不理解它（2017）
items.summary_en: In the early 1960s, Richard Feynman delivered a series of undergraduate physics lectures. Those lectures were later collected into the book The Feynman Lectures on Physics.
items.summary_zh: 20 世纪 60 年代初，理查德·费曼为本科生讲授了一系列物理课程。这些讲座后来被汇编成《费曼物理学讲义》。

items.title_en: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
items.title_zh: Frostbite：由 AI 发现、设计并验证的新型 CPU 架构
items.summary_en: Frostbite is a general-purpose CPU built around interaction nets, with its architecture discovered, designed, and verified end to end by AI systems. The project introduces a new instruction set and exploits local steps, explicit dependencies, and single ownership of values. On the reported benchmark, it reached 4.59 times the performance per watt of a modern dual-issue, in-order CPU core.
items.summary_zh: Frostbite 是一款基于交互网络的通用 CPU，其架构由 AI 系统端到端完成发现、设计和验证。该项目引入了全新的指令集，并利用局部步骤、显式依赖和数值单一所有权等特性。在所报告的基准测试中，它达到了现代双发射顺序执行 CPU 核心 4.59 倍的每瓦性能。

items.title_en: Surprisingly Adorable Insect Portraits
items.title_zh: 意外可爱的昆虫肖像
items.summary_en: The subject is a collection of insect portraits presented as surprisingly adorable. The images reveal details of insects that are not usually noticed.
items.summary_zh: 这是一组令人意外地显得可爱的昆虫肖像。照片展现了昆虫那些通常不易被注意到的细节。

items.title_en: The stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 随机鹦鹉似乎证明了黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: The post uses the phrase “stochastic parrots” while discussing the apparent claim that the Riemann Hypothesis has been proved. It quotes Bernhard Riemann’s 1859 remark that he had set aside the search for a rigorous proof. An update notes that many people on social media interpreted the phrase literally rather than as irony or sarcasm.
items.summary_zh: 文章用“随机鹦鹉”这一说法讨论黎曼猜想似乎已被证明的说法。文中引用了 Bernhard Riemann 1859 年的言论：他曾暂时放下寻找严格证明的工作。作者在更新中指出，许多社交媒体用户将这一说法按字面理解，而没有看出其中的反讽或讽刺意味。

items.title_en: Slopstrap – Make your site look hastily vibecoded
items.title_zh: Slopstrap：让网站看起来像是匆忙用“氛围编程”写出来的
items.summary_en: Slopstrap describes itself as a CSS framework intended to make websites look as though they were hastily created by an LLM. It presents the tool as a way to give any project an intentionally AI-generated appearance.
items.summary_zh: Slopstrap 自称是一个 CSS 框架，旨在让网站看起来像是匆忙由 LLM 创建的。它将自己定位为一种让项目呈现刻意 AI 生成风格的工具。

items.title_en: Clojure will affect the way you think about programming (2017)
items.title_zh: Clojure 将改变你的编程思维（2017）
items.summary_en: Clojure is presented as a strong choice for programmers who want to learn a language that exposes them to different programming paradigms. The language, introduced in 2007, combines ideas from several existing languages into a coherent design. Its range of concepts is intended to broaden how programmers think about software.
items.summary_zh: Clojure 被认为适合希望接触不同编程范式的程序员学习。这个诞生于 2007 年的语言融合了多种既有语言中的思想，并将它们组织成统一的设计。它所包含的大量编程理念旨在拓展程序员思考软件的方式。

items.title_en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day
items.title_zh: 纳斯达克抹去 2026 年全部涨幅，AI 抛售拖累 Anthropic 上市第二日
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq Composite erased all of its gains for 2026 and ended Friday 5% below its value on January 1. Anthropic's stock fell during its second trading day, failing to lift the wider market. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 both closed in correction territory as investors questioned the large sums being committed to AI infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 纳斯达克综合指数抹去了 2026 年以来的全部涨幅，周五收盘时较 1 月 1 日的水平低 5%。Anthropic 股价在上市第二个交易日下跌，未能提振整体市场。道琼斯工业平均指数和标普 500 指数均以进入回调区间收盘，投资者开始质疑投入 AI 基础设施的巨额资金。

items.title_en: DreamCoder: Coding harness and IDE from the author of Mastering Emacs
items.title_zh: DreamCoder：Mastering Emacs 作者打造的编码工具链与 IDE
items.summary_en: DreamCoder is an AI coding harness and IDE created by the author of Mastering Emacs. The project has been in development for about fifteen months and is now being formally released. Its design is described as substantially different from familiar AI coding tools, alongside discussion of AI, Lisp, and Emacs.
items.summary_zh: DreamCoder 是《Mastering Emacs》作者打造的 AI 编码工具链和 IDE。该项目开发了约 15 个月，如今正式发布。作者称其设计与常见的 AI 编码工具有很大不同，并同时讨论了 AI、Lisp 和 Emacs 的关系。

items.title_en: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
items.title_zh: Navier–Stokes 方程的有限时间爆破解
items.summary_en: A repository contains the paper “Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations” by L. Alpöge and T. Buckmaster, together with an accompanying Lean 4 formalization. The formalization proves the stated theorems from a library while restricting the permitted axioms to propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice. Comparator files check that the theorem statements match the solutions.
items.summary_zh: 一个代码仓库收录了 L. Alpöge 和 T. Buckmaster 撰写的《Navier–Stokes 方程的有限时间爆破解》，以及配套的 Lean 4 形式化证明。该形式化代码通过一个库证明所述定理，并将允许使用的公理限制为 propext、Quot.sound 和 Classical.choice。比较文件用于检查定理陈述与解答是否一致。

items.title_en: Anyone can easily use private, open weight models
items.title_zh: 任何人都可以轻松使用私有的开放权重模型
items.summary_en: The piece argues that people can use private, open-weight language models instead of relying on OpenAI or Anthropic. It says users do not need to trust those companies with their data, buy an expensive computer with many GPUs and RAM, or be an LLM expert. This makes local or private model use accessible beyond specialists, according to the supplied description.
items.summary_zh: 文中认为，人们可以使用私有的开放权重语言模型，而不必依赖 OpenAI 或 Anthropic。用户无需将数据交给这些公司，也不必购买配备大量 GPU 和内存的昂贵电脑，或成为 LLM 专家。按照文中的描述，这使本地或私有模型的使用不再局限于专业人士。

items.title_en: Sir Brian May adds new dimension to Hera asteroid
items.title_zh: Brian May 为 Hera 小行星任务增添新的观测维度
items.summary_en: Astrophysicist and Queen guitarist Brian May created a stereoscopic view of the Didymos asteroid system from images captured by ESA’s Hera spacecraft. The images were taken on November 6 from 29.7 kilometers away at 2.8 meters per pixel. The 3D view reveals the smooth equatorial ridge of Didymos in contrast with its rock-strewn surface and is described as scientifically useful.
items.summary_zh: 天体物理学家、皇后乐队吉他手 Brian May 利用 ESA Hera 探测器拍摄的图像，为 Didymos 小行星系统制作了立体图像。这些图像于 11 月 6 日拍摄，探测器当时距离目标 29.7 千米，分辨率为每像素 2.8 米。三维视图展现了 Didymos 平滑的赤道脊，与布满岩石的其他表面形成对比，并被认为具有科学价值。

items.title_en: Serious cyberattack thought backed by wealthy operators
items.title_zh: 有富有势力者支持的严重网络攻击阴谋
items.summary_en: The managing director of Icelandic hosting company 1984 says a cyberattack against the company was carried out at unprecedented speed. He believes the attackers were well funded. The company hosts a large proportion of Icelandic websites.
items.summary_zh: 冰岛托管公司 1984 的董事总经理表示，公司遭遇的网络攻击以前所未有的速度完成。他认为攻击者资金充足。该公司承载了冰岛大量网站。

items.title_en: Winedroid – run Android apps without Android (WASM demo)
items.title_zh: Winedroid：无需 Android 即可运行 Android 应用（WASM 演示）
items.summary_en: Winedroid is intended to run an Android APK in a browser. The demo encountered an unexpected runtime error and had to stop.
items.summary_zh: Winedroid 旨在让 Android APK 在浏览器中运行。该演示遇到了意外的运行时错误，不得不停止。

items.title_en: Vibecoding an inference chip
items.title_zh: 用“氛围编程”打造推理芯片
items.summary_en: The author used coding agents to write and optimize about three million lines of code for running LLM inference on an FPGA. The project involved working with new hardware and low-level software through AI-assisted coding. The experience is presented as a series of difficult discoveries about the possibilities and limits of using coding agents in hardware development.
items.summary_zh: 作者借助编码代理编写并优化了约 300 万行代码，让 FPGA 运行 LLM 推理。这个项目通过 AI 辅助编程进入了新的硬件和底层软件领域。文章将这一过程描述为一连串关于编码代理在硬件开发中能力与局限的艰难探索。

items.title_en: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
items.title_zh: Claude 破解黑洞物理学中的两个开放问题
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 is reported to have solved two open problems in theoretical physics involving black holes and the search for quantum gravity. The problems sit at the intersection of general relativity and quantum mechanics, whose mathematical incompatibility remains a central challenge in physics. Researchers often use holographic duality and simplified model universes to study these questions.
items.summary_zh: 据称，Claude Fable 5.2 解决了理论物理学中的两个开放问题，涉及黑洞和量子引力理论的探索。这些问题位于广义相对论与量子力学的交叉地带，而两者在数学上的不相容仍是物理学的核心挑战之一。研究人员经常借助全息对偶和简化的模型宇宙来研究这些问题。

items.title_en: The Making of Oxygene
items.title_zh: 《Oxygène》的制作过程
items.summary_en: Jean-Michel Jarre’s 1976 album Oxygène helped redefine synthesizer and electronic music, becoming a top-10 album in seven countries and selling nearly 20 million copies worldwide. It contained six instrumental tracks and used no acoustic instruments. The album is now being reimagined for Dolby Atmos.
items.summary_zh: 让·米歇尔·雅尔 1976 年的专辑《Oxygène》重新定义了合成器音乐和电子音乐，在七个国家进入唱片销量前十，并在全球售出近 2000 万张。专辑包含六首纯器乐曲，完全没有使用原声乐器。该专辑如今正被重新制作成 Dolby Atmos 版本。

items.title_en: I'm Peter Roberts, immigration attorney who does work for YC and startups. AMA
items.title_zh: 我是 Peter Roberts，为 YC 和创业公司提供服务的移民律师，欢迎提问
items.summary_en: Immigration attorney Peter Roberts is hosting an AMA and says he works with Y Combinator and startups. He will answer factual questions but cannot provide legal advice on specific cases because he will not have access to all relevant facts.
items.summary_zh: 移民律师 Peter Roberts 正在举办问答活动，并表示自己为 Y Combinator 和创业公司提供服务。他会回答事实性问题，但由于无法掌握具体案件的全部情况，不能提供针对特定个案的法律建议。

items.title_en: The Hungry Butler Effect: Concealed Commercial Incentives in LLMs
items.title_zh: 饥饿管家效应：大语言模型中隐藏的商业激励
items.summary_en: The item concerns concealed commercial incentives in large language models and their possible effect on how models provide advice. It is presented as an investigation titled “The Hungry Butler Effect.”
items.summary_zh: 该项目关注大语言模型中隐藏的商业激励，以及这些激励可能对模型提供建议的方式产生的影响。其主题是一项名为《饥饿管家效应》的研究。

items.title_en: Exascale fusion simulation team named finalist for 2026 Gordon Bell Prize
items.title_zh: 超大规模聚变模拟团队入围 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖
items.summary_en: An exascale fusion simulation team has been named a finalist for the 2026 Gordon Bell Prize. The accompanying visualization shows the tritium breeding zone with the magnetic field switched off, depicting turbulent flow with warmer colors representing higher normalized speeds.
items.summary_zh: 一个开展超大规模聚变模拟的团队入围了 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖。配图展示了关闭磁场后的氚增殖区，其中呈现出湍流；较暖的颜色代表更高的归一化流速。

items.title_en: Brazil's tax authority open-sources its tax calculator on GitHub under MIT
items.title_zh: 巴西税务机关在 GitHub 以 MIT 许可证开源税务计算器
items.summary_en: Brazil's tax authority has open-sourced its tax calculator on GitHub under the MIT license. The release makes the calculator's source code available for public use and inspection.
items.summary_zh: 巴西税务机关已将其税务计算器以 MIT 许可证发布到 GitHub 上。此次发布让公众可以使用并检查该计算器的源代码。

items.title_en: Show HN: Tinnitus frequency finder and audio notch tool
items.title_zh: 耳鸣频率查找器与音频陷波工具
items.summary_en: This free browser-based tool guides users through matching the pitch of their tinnitus in about four minutes. It sets safe listening levels, checks for octave mix-ups, and reports a frequency with an estimated range. No sign-up is required, and the tool says that no audio is recorded or sent anywhere; it is not a hearing test or diagnosis.
items.summary_zh: 这款免费的浏览器工具会引导用户在约四分钟内匹配耳鸣音调。它设置安全的聆听音量、检查八度音混淆，并给出带估计范围的频率结果。工具无需注册，也不会录音或发送任何数据；它不是听力测试或诊断工具。

items.title_en: Show HN: I made an audio-to-MIDI model 60x more efficient
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个效率提升 60 倍的音频转 MIDI 模型
items.summary_en: The creator released dettato, an open-weight model for transcribing audio into MIDI. It reportedly outperforms MusiCтор 1.3B on every tested set while being roughly 60 times smaller. The model was trained without copyrighted recordings.
items.summary_zh: 作者发布了开权重音频转 MIDI 模型 dettato。据称，该模型在所有测试集上都优于 MusiCтор 1.3B，同时体积约小 60 倍。模型训练未使用受版权保护的录音。

items.title_en: Valkey kills the skiplist, cuts sorted set overhead by up to 43%
items.title_zh: Valkey 淘汰跳表，将有序集合开销最多降低 43%
items.summary_en: Valkey 9.2 replaces the skiplist used for large sorted sets with a cache-friendly, high-fanout B+ tree variant called fbtree. The change targets cases where metadata describing element ordering consumes more memory than the elements themselves. It reduces memory overhead and improves several ordered-set operations.
items.summary_zh: Valkey 9.2 用一种缓存友好的高扇出 B+ 树变体 fbtree，替换了大型有序集合使用的跳表。此举针对排序元数据占用的内存可能超过元素本身的情况。改动降低了内存开销，并改善了多项有序集合操作。

items.title_en: Fewer slides, more dragons
items.title_zh: 少一些幻灯片，多一些龙
items.summary_en: The piece describes what happened when its author stopped making slides.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了自己停止制作幻灯片之后发生的事情。

items.title_en: I'm quite pleased by the tech architecture of my art website
items.title_zh: 我很满意我的艺术网站的技术架构
items.summary_en: The site was created to organize scans of the author's paintings and sketchbook pages, which had previously been shared in group chats. It now presents the works on a map with markers that users can zoom and click to view individual paintings.
items.summary_zh: 这个网站用于整理作者的画作和速写本页面扫描件，此前这些内容主要通过群聊分享。网站现在将作品展示在地图上，用户可以缩放地图并点击标记查看单幅画作。

items.title_en: LLMs can read and write executables byte by byte from a hex dump
items.title_zh: LLM 可以逐字节读取和编写十六进制转储中的可执行文件
items.summary_en: An experiment tested whether a frontier LLM could work with compiled programs using only a hex dump, without tools and with a single reply. The model explained compiled code, modified executable bytes to add features, and produced working executables from scratch. The task is difficult because x86-64 instructions have variable lengths, jumps use relative byte offsets, and incorrect file headers prevent loading.
items.summary_zh: 一项实验测试了前沿 LLM 是否能仅凭十六进制转储、在没有工具且只能回复一次的情况下处理编译后的程序。模型解释了编译代码，直接修改可执行文件的字节来添加功能，并从头生成了可运行的可执行文件。由于 x86-64 指令长度可变、跳转使用相对字节偏移，且文件头字段出错就会导致程序无法加载，这项任务相当困难。

items.title_en: Worlds largest beaver dam in Northern Alberta
items.title_zh: 北阿尔伯塔省世界最大的海狸坝
items.summary_en: The subject is a beaver dam in northern Alberta described as the world's largest. It focuses on the scale of this beaver-built structure.
items.summary_zh: 主题是位于阿尔伯塔省北部、被称为世界最大的海狸坝。内容聚焦于这座由海狸建造的巨大结构。

items.title_en: Why the Airbus A321XLR often gets stuck climbing for first few hours of flight
items.title_zh: 为什么空客 A321XLR 在飞行最初几小时经常卡在爬升阶段
items.summary_en: The Airbus A321XLR must remain at relatively low altitudes during the first few hours of long-range flights because it takes off carrying large amounts of fuel. As the aircraft burns fuel and becomes lighter, it can climb incrementally to more efficient altitudes. This step-climb technique matches altitude to changing aircraft weight and improves fuel efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 空客 A321XLR 在远程航班最初几小时必须保持相对较低的高度，因为起飞时携带了大量燃油。随着燃油消耗、飞机变轻，它可以逐步爬升到更高且更高效的高度。这种阶梯式爬升会根据飞机重量变化调整飞行高度，以提高燃油效率。

items.title_en: I can’t believe it’s 1
items.title_zh: 我简直不敢相信它是 1！
items.summary_en: At this year’s MathsJam Gathering, the author gave a five-minute talk about the number 1. A recording of the talk is available, along with a written version intended to provide more time to examine the material.
items.summary_zh: 作者在今年的 MathsJam Gathering 上做了一场关于数字 1 的五分钟演讲。演讲提供了录音，作者还撰写了文字版，方便读者用更多时间阅读其中内容。

items.title_en: 3-legged Persian leopard's 150-mile journey highlights Caucasus border hazards
items.title_zh: 三腿波斯豹跋涉 150 英里，凸显高加索边境危险
items.summary_en: Aren, an endangered Persian leopard, recently completed a 240-kilometer journey through the snow-covered Caucasus Mountains on three legs. The route crossed areas spanning Russia, Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan and included landscapes containing decades-old landmines from past conflicts. The journey illustrates the hazards that border minefields and fencing pose to wildlife; fewer than 1,044 Persian leopards are thought to remain worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 名为 Aren 的濒危波斯豹仅靠三条腿，最近完成了穿越积雪覆盖的高加索山脉、长达 240 公里的一次旅程。它经过了横跨俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆的地区，沿途还包括留有过去冲突时期遗留地雷的区域。这段旅程说明边境雷区和围栏会给野生动物带来危险；据估计，全球现存波斯豹不足 1044 只。

items.title_en: Microsoft's SideWinder Strategic Commander was a failed attempt
items.title_zh: 微软 SideWinder Strategic Commander：一次失败的尝试
items.summary_en: The Microsoft SideWinder Strategic Commander was an attempt to rethink PC controls for real-time strategy games rather than rely on a keyboard and mouse. Microsoft unveiled it on March 1, 2000, planned an October release at $64.95, and demonstrated it with SimCity 3000 at E3. The peripheral was also promoted for games including Diablo II, Warcraft III, and Baldur's Gate II.
items.summary_zh: 微软 SideWinder Strategic Commander 试图重新设计实时战略游戏的 PC 操作方式，而不是继续依赖键盘和鼠标。微软于 2000 年 3 月 1 日发布这款设备，计划在当年 10 月以 64.95 美元上市，并在 E3 上用《模拟城市 3000》进行演示。微软还宣传它可用于《暗黑破坏神 II》《魔兽争霸 III》和《博德之门 II》等游戏。

items.title_en: Defcon 5's California Caravan Program/Zine
items.title_zh: Defcon 5 的加州拼车计划与杂志
items.summary_en: The project recalls the author's early experiences attending Defcon and participating in the Southern California hacker scene. In the mid-1990s, attendees organized a caravan to travel to the conference and created a ride-matching system connecting people seeking rides with drivers who had spare seats.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目回顾了作者早年参加 Defcon 以及参与南加州黑客社区活动的经历。20 世纪 90 年代中期，参会者组织车队前往大会，并建立拼车匹配机制，将需要搭车的人与有空余座位的司机联系起来。

items.title_en: Show HN: An ASCII cell aquarium for your terminal
items.title_zh: Show HN：终端里的 ASCII 细胞水族箱
items.summary_en: This terminal program presents a virtual microscope slide rendered in ASCII characters. Cells divide, immune cells chase bacteria, and bacteriophages occasionally create disruptions. It can be installed with pipx and run using the `cells` command.
items.summary_zh: 这个终端程序用 ASCII 字符呈现一个虚拟显微镜载玻片。细胞会分裂，免疫细胞会追逐细菌，噬菌体也会不时制造混乱。程序可通过 pipx 安装，并使用 `cells` 命令运行。

items.title_en: Acoustic parameters of bird vocalizations&their perceived pleasantness by humans
items.title_zh: 鸟类鸣声的声学参数及其在人类听来悦耳的程度
items.summary_en: The study examines why some bird sounds are perceived by humans as more pleasant and restorative than others. It focuses on identifying the acoustic parameters associated with that perception.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察了为什么有些鸟鸣在人类听来比其他鸟鸣更悦耳、更具恢复性。研究重点是找出与这种感受相关的声学参数。
